prompts.name: baseline
prompts.description: One task-general child per request, using only participating parent instructions and operator requirements. No task context or performance feedback is injected.
prompts.both: First combine useful guidance from BOTH parents into a coherent crossover instruction; do not simply concatenate them. Then mutate the crossover by changing its decision steps, focus, or structure to explore a useful alternative. Return exactly {"crossover":"combined instruction","instruction":"mutated instruction"}. Keep crossover within {{MAX_CROSSOVER_TOKENS}} tokens and instruction within {{MAX_INSTRUCTION_TOKENS}} tokens. Prefer concise fields so the complete JSON fits the output budget.
prompts.crossover_only: Combine useful guidance from BOTH parents into one coherent instruction, resolving redundancy or conflicting guidance. Do not simply concatenate them or perform a separate mutation. Return exactly {"crossover":"combined instruction"}. Keep it within {{MAX_CROSSOVER_TOKENS}} tokens. This field will be used directly as the child instruction.
prompts.mutation_only: Mutate the supplied parent instruction by changing its decision steps, focus, or structure to explore a useful alternative. Do not perform crossover. Return exactly {"instruction":"mutated instruction"}. Keep it within {{MAX_INSTRUCTION_TOKENS}} tokens.
